Publishing House operator

Run publication-profile-driven editorial work through a resumable, policy-bound Kujo control loop.

Audience
all
Difficulty
advanced
Status
production-capable control plane
Version
current
Updated
2026-09-02

The Publishing House Operator is the small, durable control layer above Kujo's eleven Publishing House workflows, released in kujo-workflows 0.4.0. It wakes for a manual, scheduled, or event-driven run, reads eligible work from StoryDesk, acquires a local lease, selects the narrowest workflow, records checkpoints and receipts, and exits. Agents are bounded workers; they are not the scheduler, state database, or publication authority.

Ownership
flowchart TD
Scheduler[Manual, cron, launchd, or event] --> Operator[Publishing House Operator]
Operator --> StoryDesk[StoryDesk: editorial queue and state]
Operator --> Dispatch[Dispatch: retry and resume]
Dispatch --> Workers[Bounded Agents SDK workers]
Workers --> Dossier[Dossier: claims and evidence]
Workers --> BluePencil[BluePencil: independent review]
Workers --> GalleyPack[GalleyPack: versions and lineage]
Workers --> AssetWorks[AssetWorks and Howl: media]
GalleyPack --> VersionSeal[VersionSeal: exact-version authority]
VersionSeal --> PressWire[PressWire: bounded publication effects]
PressWire --> Verification[SiteProbe and Lens: verification]
Verification --> Learning[ReaderSignal and WebOps: measurement]
Learning --> StoryDesk
